mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline universally.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 0.2% for 3 months, it triggers a monetary easing cycle that accelerates credit availability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been below 0.2% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in UNRATE and increases in PAYEMS indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: High RSAFS and HOUST values signal robust consumer spending and housing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST exceed 5-year averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO signals manufacturing strength that correlates with rising corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% annualized triggers inflation concerns that prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >40% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases reflect labor market strength that elevates wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-growth (GDPC1 < 1% quarterly) and high-unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) regimes, FEDFUNDS stability prevents recessionary fears, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when GDPC1 < 1% and UNRATE > 5%.
